title: A Happy Ending

learningObjectivesZh: 理解娜娜施咒及解除咒语的因果关系
体会王子和燕子对彼此的关心
说明结尾三位伙伴选择怎样帮助他人

sections.title: A Joyful Reunion
sections.summaryZh: 王子恢复人形，燕子也平安无事。他们惊喜地相认，并向老鹰询问原因。

sections.title: The Truth About the Spell
sections.summaryZh: 老鹰原来是保姆娜娜。她因王子曾经缺乏善意而施咒，希望教会他仁慈；真正解除咒语的是王子与燕子帮助他人的行动。王子选择原谅娜娜。

sections.title: A Difficult Goodbye
sections.summaryZh: 天气变冷，王子担心燕子再度冻僵。虽然两人各有去处，却都不愿分开，娜娜提出一个新办法。

sections.title: A New Way to Help
sections.summaryZh: 三位伙伴一起离开小镇，没有躲回城堡，而是亲自游历王国并帮助需要帮助的人。故事末尾揭晓了叙述者的身份。

vocabulary.example: The children jumped with glee when the surprise arrived.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 惊喜到来时，孩子们欢呼雀跃。

vocabulary.example: A statue stood in the middle of the square.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 广场中央立着一座雕像。

vocabulary.example: The nursemaid cared for the young prince.
The old castle had a dark dungeon.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 古老的城堡里有一间阴暗的地牢。

vocabulary.example: A little kindness can change someone's day.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 一点善意就能改变别人一天的心情。

vocabulary.example: The prince decided to forgive his old friend.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 王子决定原谅他的老朋友。

vocabulary.example: The cold wind moved the bird's feathers.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 寒风吹动了鸟儿的羽毛。

vocabulary.example: The little bird might freeze in the snow.
She whispered a secret plan to her friends.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 她向朋友们低声说出一个秘密计划。

vocabulary.exampleZh: 他们明白善意比珠宝更重要。

questions.question: What surprises the prince at the beginning of this episode?

options.text: He has become a statue again.
He is a boy again, and Swallow is safe.
He has suddenly become a king.
Nana has left the town forever.

questions.explanation: 开头王子发现自己恢复了男孩的身体，而且燕子也平安无事，这是两人重逢时最大的惊喜。

questions.question: Why did Nana turn the prince into a statue?

options.text: She wanted to take his place as ruler.
She wanted to keep him from meeting Swallow.
She wanted to hide him from his parents.
She wanted to teach him to become kinder.

questions.explanation: 娜娜解释说，王子过去不够善良，她将他变成雕像是为了让他体会冷漠并学习善待他人。

questions.question: What actually broke the spell on the prince?

options.text: The kindness the prince and Swallow showed to others.
A new spell that Nana secretly cast.
The king's order to free the prince.
A special jewel hidden in the statue.

questions.explanation: 老鹰明确指出，解除咒语的不是她自己，而是王子和燕子帮助他人的善行。

questions.question: Why does the prince tell Swallow to fly to Egypt?

options.text: He wants to travel alone.
He thinks Egypt has a better castle.
He worries that the cold could freeze Swallow again.
He wants Swallow to bring back a jewel.

questions.explanation: 王子看到天气变冷，担心燕子再次被冻僵，因此催促它前往温暖的埃及。

questions.question: What do the prince, Swallow, and Hawk choose to do at the end?

options.text: Stay safely inside the castle.
Travel together and help people who need them.
Return to the statue in the town square.
Give away all the jewels in the castle.

questions.explanation: 结尾三位伙伴没有躲进城堡，而是一起游历王国，靠双手和善心帮助有需要的人。
